artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan gating deploy-headless.sh's post-deploy consumer-freshness scan behind a default-OFF --consumer-report flag, preserving byte-compatible CONSUMERS_STALE= output and exit-code neutrality.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's core scripts, `-h|--help` is implemented as a fixed line-range extraction of the file's own comment header (e.g. deploy-headless.sh: `sed -n '2,91p' "$0"`; verify-deploy.sh: `2,68p`; validate-state.sh: `2,107p`; check-consumer-freshness.sh: `2,40p`). Any edit that ADDS lines to such a script's header silently breaks its --help output -- the range then truncates mid-block or leaks post-header code lines -- with no test or gate catching it. Whenever a task adds flag documentation or header prose to one of these scripts, recalculating the sed range must be an explicit, numbered sub-step of the same phase, and a --help assertion belongs in the matching tests/ suite. Grep pattern to find all affected scripts: `grep -rn "sed -n '2," agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/*.sh`.
